title: Simple WOL Server
shortDescription: Lightweight Wake-on-LAN daemon and multi-device management hub for Fire TV and Android TV.
longDescription:
Simple WOL Server is a high-performance Wake-on-LAN daemon and multi-device manager engineered specifically for Amazon Fire TV, Android TV, and smart displays.

Running as an uninterrupted foreground background service, it hosts an embedded HTTP REST API and a modern web dashboard. Wake PCs, home servers, NAS systems, and game consoles directly using your Fire TV remote, web browser, or home automation platforms (Home Assistant, Apple Shortcuts, Node-RED).

Key Capabilities:
- Remote D-Pad Navigation: Clean 10-foot TV interface with focus indicators and high-contrast dark theme.
- Multi-Device Support: Manage unlimited target machines with custom MAC addresses, broadcast IPs, and ports.
- Embedded Web Dashboard: Full web-based control panel accessible from any browser on the local network.
- REST API: Secure endpoints for direct integration with smart home ecosystems.
- Subnet Device Scanner: Auto-discover active computers and network hardware on the local network.
- Live Status Monitor: Continuous ICMP and TCP latency monitoring with online indicators.
- Scheduled Auto-Wake: Program automatic wake triggers by time and day of week.
- Multi-Language Support: English, Deutsch, and Русский.
featureBullets: Wake PCs, servers, NAS units, and consoles via Magic Packet broadcast
